newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight report sees some inquiry.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight report sees some inquiry.

text.p: Some easing of rates and a fair level of new inquiry marked the London sugar freight market on Wednesday. Mauritius Sugar confirmed fixing Anangel Liberty for 17,500/18,000 bulk sugar Port Louis/London for September 30/ October 3 at sterling 14.25, down 50 pence from last done.

These charterers introduced a fresh inquiry on the same route on Wednesdasy of 14.750 tonnes for October 7/11. Further East Nissho Iawai were understood to have covered 17,000 tonnes bulk sugar Thailand/Japan for September 24/28 at less than $15.00. Booker fixed 8/12,000 tonnes bulk sugar Georgetown, Guyana /UK or Nantes for prompt loading on private terms.

Some new business was quoted from Brazil. Glencore have 22,500 bulk sugar Santos/Dubai for October 1/10, Genoc 14,000 bagged S Brazil/Black Sea, Red Sea or Pakistan for prompt shipment, and Cargill 14,000 N Brazil/Casablanca option Tunisia, Egypt, Syria, Black Sea or Baltic.

Cargill also now quote 25,000/5 bulk sugar from Philippines to US East or West Coast or US Gulf for October 5/15. Genoc have new orders of 13,000 bulk sugar Maputo/Marseilles for Sept/Oct and 4,000 bagged sugar Antwerp-Rouen range to Algeria for early October.
